snippet.title: TALI - A Roman Empire Game of Chance
snippet.description:
Attention all Romans! In celebration of Saturnalia, all are invited to take part in a tournament of TALI. Should you prove worthy you could find yourself showered in glory and riches, and earn the chance to face Gaius Julius Caesar Augustus himself!

TALI is available April 22, 2025 on playdate Catalog.
